Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your message. Our proposed terms are in the term sheet of this message.
Labour cost index DE, manufacturing changed +2.7% from 2025-06 to 2026-06 (idx:LCI-C@2025-06, idx:LCI-C@2026-06).
We placed our last 3 orders for this part at EUR 348.32 per unit (po:4500014474-10, po:4500014413-10, po:4500014350-20).
Could you send us a breakdown of the costs behind your price?

Best regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,
Thank you for your e-mail, which we have reviewed internally.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €370.25 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel.
For your information:
We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part.
Your figures confirm our case: that driver rose.
We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
While we acknowledge your reference to previous order prices, the significant increase in copper costs necessitates an adjustment to our current pricing.
To support our ongoing partnership, we are prepared to offer a revised price of EUR 370.25 while maintaining the standard 30-day payment terms.
Our colleagues will address your request for a cost breakdown separately.
Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown.
Should you require further information, please let us know.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
